title: Image text wrap docx 002
notes: real floating picture with square wrap: python-docx has no float API, so add_picture creates the image part/rels/inline drawing first, then word/document.xml is rewritten via zip_read/zip_write to upgrade wp:inline to wp:anchor (distT/B/L/R, simplePos, relativeHeight, behindDoc, locked, layoutInCell, allowOverlap, positionH/positionV) with wp:wrapSquare wrapSide="both" and wp:extent 2in x 1.5in (1828800 x 1371600 EMU); the a:graphic/pic:pic payload and media rel are the real python-docx ones.
